name: Rakuten Group, Inc.
verdict: Rakuten Group, Inc., a Tokyo-listed internet conglomerate with dispersed ownership. Nothing found.
aliases: 楽天グループ株式会社
note: Kit sponsor of Vissel Kobe 2026-27 per https://www.vissel-kobe.co.jp/partner/uniform-partners/ . Rating note: largest holders are trust banks, the Mikitani family's Crimson Group and founder Hiroshi Mikitani; JAPAN POST HOLDINGS holds 6.04% but the Japanese government's residual stake in Japan Post Holdings keeps any indirect state holding in Rakuten Group below 5% and there is no control or board seat.
